title: O Soul-bride, Without Your Husband Lord, What
summary: Gratitude is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?
lifeApplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?
source.lifeApplication: Gratitude becomes more truthful when o soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?.

evidence.coreClaim: O soul-bride, without your Husband Lord, what good are your decorations?
evidence.turn: Gratitude steadies when o Nanak, blessed is that fortunate bride, who is in love with her Husband.
evidence.practicalImplication: Let one received thing become a place of praise instead of entitlement. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
